Songs from the Plays

Hymn to the Sun, from 
The Indian Queen

Y
OU
 to whom Victory we owe,
Whose glories rise
By sacrifice
And from our fates below,
Never did your Altars shine
Feasted with Blood so near divine.
Princes to whom we bow,
As they to you,
Thus you can ravish from a throne,
And by their loss of pow’r declare your own.
